items.name: White staff
items.description: A basic white staff.

items.name: Wooden crossbow
items.description: A crossbow is a ranged weapon using an elastic launching device consisting of a bow-like assembly called a prod, mounted horizontally on a main frame called a tiller, which is hand-held in a similar fashion to the stock of a long gun. Crossbows shoot arrow-like projectiles called bolts or quarrels. A person who shoots crossbow is called a crossbowman, an arbalister or an arbalist

items.name: Broadsword
items.description: A sword with a huge, broad blade. You can barely hold it upright.

items.name: Wooden bow
items.description: A basic bow made of oak.

items.name: Flaming sword
items.description: The blade of the sword burns bright, it seems the flames won't die down no matter how hard anyone tries to put them out.

items.name: Iron sword
items.description: A basic iron sword, probably given to new recruits considering how worn it is.

items.name: Golden sword
items.description: Quite a heavy blade, it is engraved from hilt to tip with intricate details. Don't you think you're better off selling this?

items.name: Iron mace
items.description: A heavy hunk of steel on a stick, it'll probably crack a few skulls.

items.name: Iron sabre
items.description: A light sword with a handguard, feels like it came from a foreign land.

items.name: Fireball scroll
items.description:
A scroll that describes the methods of casting a fireball spell. Watch your fingers.

<color=#F1C40F> Allows the user to cast a fireball. Does a lot of damage. </color>

items.name: A scrawled note
items.description:
Hauled in a mighty fine catch this time. Seven women and ten men, each healthy and strong. Top-quality goods. Captain doesn't know yet where we'll sell them, but for merchandise like this, we're sure to get a good price anywhere. Perhaps we'll sail to Sarokos.

There's this one we've got who's damned pretty - but a damned pain the arse, too. If not for that, I'd keep her for myself. But when she's not bawling her eyes out, she's yelling threats at us. Demands we let her go or drop her off at Brava's temple. And that if we don't, her brother will sail after her and slaughter us all. 

First three days at sea were quiet, but now a storm's blowing in. Blasted weather. 

<color=#F1C40F> The rest of the text is unrecognizable. </color>

items.name: Pearl necklace
items.description:
A pretty necklace. Might fetch a fair price. 

Market value: <color=#F1C40F> 5 Doubloons </color>

items.name: Health potion
items.description:
A foul smelling liquid, it shimmers in a peculiar red color. 

<color=#EF5350> Restores 50 HP </color>

items.name: Mana potion
items.description:
A sweet smelling liquid, it is a muddy blue color. 

<color=#3498DB> Restores 30 MP </color>

items.name: Potion of life
items.description:
An extraordinary nectar that seeped in from the heavens. 

<color=#EF5350> Increases max HP by 5 </color>
